releases.name: Release v0.18.0
releases.notes:
Release v0.18.0

Mostly improvements and maintenance work: adds Fedora 44 support, enhances libvirt with new console, graphical console, journal output, and configurable `virtiofsd` support, improves boot and SSH reliability, and includes various CI, documentation, and infrastructure updates.

## Installation

Download the appropriate binary for your platform from the assets below.

### Linux x86_64 (glibc)
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/releases/download/v0.18.0/bcvk-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
tar xzf bcvk-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
sudo mv bcvk-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu /usr/local/bin/bcvk
```


## Checksums

Verify the integrity of your download with the provided SHA256 checksums.

## What's Changed
* Updates for Fedora 44 release by @jeckersb in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/271
* Justfile: Remove fedora-bootc:42, add fedora-bootc:{43,44} by @jeckersb in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/272
* docs: Fix incorrect flag in to-disk example by @gursewak1997 in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/275
* Add --virtiofsd CLI option and VIRTIOFSD_BIN env var support by @nickryand in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/266
* libvirt: add --console-log and --platform-console-log options by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/264
* libvirt: Add opt-in --graphical-console flag for SPICE display by @jeckersb in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/195
* ephemeral: Fix boot for images without virtiofs dracut module by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/273
* Fix SSH polling, disable Ignition+FCOS for now by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/281
* ci: Enable merge queue support by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/283
* kit: extract CommonSshOptions into ssh_options.rs by @tnk4on in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/280
* libvirt: Set LC_ALL=C for virsh commands by @tnk4on in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/286
* Add support for journal output by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/268
* Sync common files from infra repository by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/288
* Sync common files from infra repository by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/289
* chore: Configure Renovate by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/287
* Release 0.18.0 by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/278

## New Contributors
* @nickryand made their first contribution in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/266
* @tnk4on made their first contribution in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/280

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/compare/v0.17.0...v0.18.0

releases.name: Release v0.11.0
releases.notes:
Release v0.11.0

There's mainly bugfixes here, but a key one is

* qemu: Add --allow-mmap to virtiofsd for mmap support by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/201

which fixes several important things in `bcvk ephemeral`.

A small new feature is

* Introduce `allow-missing-fsverity` parameter by @Johan-Liebert1 in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/205

Besides that we mainly have some preparatory work on distribution packaging (we now also publish binaries as OCI artifacts), some CI/infra tweaks as well etc.

* Sync common files from infra repository by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/194
* Add Packit automation for COPR builds and Fedora packaging by @gursewak1997 in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/196
* Sync common files from infra repository by @bootc-bot[bot] in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/197
* integration-tests: Remove ignore_status() that hides failures by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/203
* credentials: Use remote-fs.target for virtiofs mount ordering by @cgwalters in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/204
* Add 60s timeout for `test_run_ephemeral_with_instancetype` and bump CI instance to u1.micro. by @gursewak1997 in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/208
* Publish development binaries as OCI artifacts by @gursewak1997 in https://github.com/bootc-dev/bcvk/pull/198
